# Antigravity Master Agent Suite

> Autonomous Multi-Agent Suite for Enterprise SDLC, Design, Procurement, & Verification

## Purpose
This repository serves as the canonical persistent registry for 28 specialized Antigravity subagents, operating under a unified lifecycle: goal -> worktree -> evidence -> acceptance gate. It is built on zero emotional self-praise, strict 3rd-party verification, structured inter-agent handoff envelopes, and non-negotiable write boundaries.

## Features
- Production-grade multi-agent execution framework.
- 28 specialized subagents across 6 functional clusters.
- Zero emotional self-praise; progress requires quantitative metrics.
- Supplied source immutability (local staging with SHA256 integrity checks).
- 3rd-party verification requirement for all tasks.

## Agent Clusters
1. Orchestration & Governance (workflow-orchestrator, team-work-orchestrator, team-work-verifier)
2. Architecture, Development & Verification (system-architect, lead-developer, audit-qa-verifier, database-graph-architect)
3. Specialized Design, Publishing & Art Direction (creative-visual-art-director, figma-app-uiux-designer, web-publishing-specialist, design-system-formatter)
4. Requirements, Cost Estimation & Procurement (requirements-spec-analyst, function-point-estimator, g2b-rfp-crawler)
5. 3D Graphics, Video Synthesis & Game Engine (video-media-synthesis-specialist, game-3d-unreal-blender-engine-developer)
6. Research, Mail, Archiving & Operations (8 specialized agents including academic-research-benchmarker, technical-writer, etc.)

## Project Information
- Maintainer: Shin Jaehyun (Wylie)
- Status: Fully Verified (28 Agents)
- Runtime: Antigravity / Gemini 3.6
